institution: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bhopal
citation: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Bhopal. Antibiogram-AIIMS, Bhopal (1st July to 31st December 2024). Bhopal: AIIMS Bhopal.
reporting: Percent susceptible with the number of isolates tested per drug, by organism, hospital-wide (all specimens and all locations together, Tables 5 and 6); isolate counts by specimen (Tables 1 and 2) and by location (Tables 3 and 4).
method: First isolate of each organism per patient in the period; final verified results interpreted by the current CLSI and EUCAST guidelines; organisms with at least 15 isolates included, those with 15 to 30 marked; Burkholderia species also included below 15, as stated in the report.

verification.note: Tables 1 to 6 parsed from the PDF text layer by word positions (rotated drug headers rebuilt from characters, trend arrows stripped), count tables re-added by row and by column against their printed totals; every value of every extracted table then compared by eye with the rendered page images (full pages at scale 3 and zoomed crops), 2026-09-26. The archived PDF was re-downloaded and matched the census file byte for byte (MD5).

notes: Half-yearly hospital antibiogram of AIIMS Bhopal, 1st July to 31st December 2024: 4964 isolates as printed. Rows are hospital-wide (spec all, set all): Tables 5 and 6 pool all specimens and all locations (OPD, IPD, ICU and Emergency), each cell giving percent susceptible over the number of isolates tested; drugs printed as -, NR, IR or R are left out. Counts: Tables 1 and 2 (by specimen, all locations) and Tables 3 and 4 (by location, all specimens) are two views of the same isolates, recorded as spec x all and all x setting, with each organism's Total from Table 1 or 2 as the all x all count; IPD is recorded as ward. The Emergency column and the Others specimen column have no key and are not recorded, nor are cells printed as "-", so the recorded location or specimen counts add up to less than each organism's total. Tables 7 and 8 (percent susceptible by specimen for all Gram-negative or all Gram-positive isolates pooled) are not organism-specific and were not extracted. Up and down arrows (a change of more than 5 points from the previous half-year) are not values and are ignored. 6 other printed percentages differ by up to 1 point from any whole number of the isolates printed as tested (the percentage and the tested count appear to use slightly different denominators); these are kept as printed. Archived copy used (the live site could not be reached): https://web.archive.org/web/20250215083642id_/https://aiimsbhopal.edu.in/AIIMSFiles/annexuredImage/Antibiogram_AIIMS_BHopal_Jul-Dec_2024.pdf.
